w: After his morning puja, Swamishri worshipped the canvas murtis to be established at a moral center in Jolva.

At 11.00 a.m., Swamishri blessed the assembly, "We have listened to the glory of the Swaminarayan mantra from the former speakers... Out of all strengths, the power of God is supreme. Some exercise the power to rule, some have money power and some have the power of scriptural knowledge; everyone talks of their powers but above all is God’s power. Everything is under His powers. Where did people get their powers and strengths? From God! So God is all-powerful. It is because of Him the world runs... If God has so much power then His name too has power. It is all a matter of having faith. We have faith in our businesses and thus invest millions of rupees because we know that we will get a thousand-fold back. Likewise, one requires faith in God."

At 6.55 p.m. Swamishri left Bharuch and reached Navsari at 7.37 p.m. In addressing the assembly of devotees Swamishri said, "After the establishment of this mandir in Navsari there has been a tremendous progress in the local Satsang... On Sundays people spend their day partying or travelling around but Yogiji Maharaj has said that our Sundays should be spent in such a way that we experience peace of mind..."
This morning, Swamishri departed from Mumbai to Gandhinagar to bless and welcome Mr. Bill Clinton in his visit to Akshardham.

With the prevailing communal violence in Gujarat, some leading citizens had requested Swamishri to make an appeal for peace. A video recording of Swamishri's message was arranged and it was telecasted in the news program throughout Gujarat.

Thirty-six tribal people from the Dang district sang traditional bhajans during Swamishri's morning walk. A sadhu sang a bhajan in the Dangi language and explained the activities of BAPS and glory of Swamishri. Thereafter a couple of tribals narrated their transformation through their association with Satsang. Finally Swamishri blessed the tribals and initiated them into Satsang.

Swamishri attended a special volunteer's assembly in the morning. After Swamishri's arrival at 10.30 a.m. Thereafter they enacted a drama 'Commando' showing the discipline and sacrifice of BAPS volunteers. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.

ds.t: Not a single leaf will move
w: After yesterday's opening ceremony of the water show, the dignitaries present poured out a flood of comments. These were told to Swamishri during his morning meal. Ishwarcharan Swami and all the sadhus running this show were sitting, and one comment after another kept flowing. There was joy on every face. Brahmavihari Swami and Aksharvatsal Swami described the comments of the dignitaries who had come yesterday.

During the conversation Brahmavihari Swami said to Swamishri, "First of all, thank you, because two days ago, when testing was going on, the wind was blowing and the amphitheatre steps were getting wet, and everyone was wondering, 'What will happen at the opening?' That is why we came rushing to you and requested, 'Please bless us so that the wind does not blow.' When everyone was worried, you alone were steady. You only said, 'Shriji Maharaj keeps our honour every time; so that we do not become proud and we stay on the ground, God does everything.' Even then we were not yet convinced. The day after we spoke, there was still wind. And you had said, 'Not a single leaf will move, God will be kind,' but yesterday at 4:00 in the evening there was still wind. So the worry kept growing. Today you took care of the smallest needs of the invited guests. Even at 5:00 in the evening you phoned and asked about the arrangements for all these guests, asked the smallest details, but in ten or fifteen minutes of talk you asked nothing at all about the wind. How much faith you have in Shriji Maharaj! So we all believe it is only your grace. If you had not held back the wind, what would have happened? In truth you are God. If you were not God, this would not be possible."
Swamishri said at once, "Where did that come from? Where are we God?"
"If not, who could show such divine power?"
Swamishri said, "God speaks, Shastriji Maharaj and Jogi Bapa speak. They are the ones who speak. They are also the doers."
"They speak, but by dwelling in you, don't they?"

Swamishri said nothing. So Brahmavihari Swami said, "When everyone was worried, there was tremendous calm on your face. You had said that Maharaj has never let our honour go so far. Not a single leaf will move. All of this came true yesterday. Not a single leaf moved. A video has been taken too."
Of course, all this praise did not touch Swamishri in the least. He stayed steady in himself, untouched.

Then came a flood, as it were, of comments overflowing with praise from many dignitaries who had enjoyed the water show yesterday. There was a feeling of pride in everyone's hearts. Everyone's joy could not be contained. One after another, everyone shared the comments they had heard. Swamishri too heard these comments, but without being carried away by this flood of praise, right after the meal Swamishri became busy in a meeting about the arrangements for a mandir in a small town. Swamishri himself had called the devotees of Jambusar. After the meeting with them, Swamishri called Nikhilesh Swami and said, "Those Jambusar devotees are going to stay here, so make all the arrangements for them to see the show, and arrange their lunch too."
This was a glimpse of Swamishri's evenness and closeness towards everyone.

ds.t: Julian leaves with peace in his heart
w: From 4:00 in the afternoon, Julian, business manager of ECA2, had been sitting waiting for Swamishri's darshan. He had already had Swamishri's darshan yesterday, but today before leaving he felt inspired and expressed his wish not to go without darshan. Also, seeing the sacred thread (nadachhadi) tied on Yves Pepin's wrist, he too wished to have one tied. He said to Swamishri, "I have come to thank you. I am leaving today. I was here only two days, but today I am going back with peace in my heart. I travel the whole world and do big projects, but I have never felt such divine joy anywhere. I will remember you every day and remember the work done with the organisation. I wish to give up cigarettes, and my prayer is that everyone who works with me, and everyone else, is happy."
Swamishri was pleased to see his feeling and blessed him.

ds.t: Only one photo on his office wall
w: Anilbhai Naik, MD and CEO and head of Larsen and Toubro (L&T), came to receive Swamishri's blessings. In the past month he had received three awards, including the Padma Bhushan from the central government. Drawn by Swamishri's divinity and saintliness, he is not just an admirer of satsang; he has become a satsangi. He always keeps the sacred thread (nadachhadi) that Swamishri tied on his wrist. Showing it now, he said to Swamishri, "Look, I always keep it with me. I take it off only once a year and immediately have another tied."
Today too Swamishri tied a new nadachhadi for him.
He also said, "Whoever comes to my office, there is only one photo on my wall, and that is of Pramukh Swami Maharaj."
